By executing an Order Form, accessing the Services, or electronically accepting these Terms, Client agrees to be bound by them. In case of conflict between these Terms and an executed Order Form, the Order Form shall control solely with respect to commercial terms.

## 1\. Definitions

[Copy link to 1. Definitions](https://www.gushwork.ai/terms-and-conditions#definitions) Link copied

02. **“Client”** means the entity identified as the customer in the Short-Form Service Agreement.
03. **“Service Provider”** means Regents Inc. (D/B/A Gushwork), including its affiliates, officers, employees, and contractors.
04. **“Services”** means AI-assisted managed growth, inbound demand generation, digital visibility optimization, content operations, website optimization, analytics, automation, reporting, campaign management, conversion optimization, and related professional services provided by Service Provider, as detailed in applicable Order Forms.
05. **“Deliverables”** means customer-specific outputs, reports, dashboards, campaigns, and digital assets expressly identified in an applicable Order Form and produced for Client in the course of providing the Services.
06. **“Customer Deliverables”** means customer-branded, customer-specific outputs expressly identified in an Order Form, including approved published website materials, lead data outputs, analytics configurations, and final creative assets produced for Client.
07. **“Order Form” or “SOW”** means a mutually executed ordering document referencing these Terms that specifies the Services, Deliverables, fees, term, and commercial conditions.
08. **“Confidential Information”** means all non-public information disclosed by either Party that is marked or otherwise understood to be confidential, including business, financial, technical, or customer data.
09. **“Intellectual Property Rights”** means all current and future worldwide rights in patents, copyrights, trademarks, trade secrets, know-how, and similar proprietary rights.
10. **“Effective Date”** means the commencement date of the Agreement as specified in the Short-Form Service Agreement.
11. **“AI Systems”** means machine learning models, large language models, generative AI systems, automation systems, recommendation engines, and AI-assisted software tools used by Service Provider in delivering the Services.
12. **“Usage Thresholds”** means operational assumptions, publishing limits, campaign limits, support limits, or service assumptions associated with a selected service package, as specified in the applicable Order Form.
13. **“ICP (Ideal Customer Profile)”** means the description of Client’s target buyer persona, industry verticals, company size, geography, and qualification criteria agreed in writing by the Parties.
14. **“Term”** means the initial term and any renewal terms of the Agreement, as defined in the Term & Termination section.

6. **Acceptable Use.** Client agrees to use the Services and Deliverables lawfully and in good faith, and not to: (a) publish fraudulent, defamatory, or infringing material; (b) engage in spam or deceptive marketing; (c) infringe third-party intellectual property; or (d) interfere with Service Provider's systems. ## 7\. Termination & Effect of Termination

[Copy link to 7. Termination & Effect of Termination](https://www.gushwork.ai/terms-and-conditions#termination-effect-of-termination) Link copied

1. **Initial & Renewal Term.** This Agreement shall have an initial term of twelve (12) months commencing on the Effective Date (“Initial Term”) and shall automatically renew for successive twelve (12) month periods (each, a “Renewal Term”) unless either Party provides written notice of non-renewal at least thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the then-current term.

2. **Lock-in and Mid-Term Review.** Customer agrees that this Agreement shall have a minimum lock-in period of six (6) months from the Effective Date (and from the start of each Renewal Term), during which it may not be terminated for convenience. After the completion of the six-month period, the Customer may terminate the Agreement for convenience upon thirty (30) days’ prior written notice, subject to the completion of a performance review of the Services conducted jointly by the Parties. If no such termination notice is given, the Agreement shall continue for the remainder of the Initial or Renewal Term.

3. **Termination for Cause.** Either Party may terminate this Agreement for cause with immediate effect (i) if the other Party materially breaches any of its obligations and fails to cure such breach within fifteen (15) days of receiving written notice; (ii) if the other Party becomes the subject of a bankruptcy, insolvency, receivership, liquidation, assignment for the benefit of creditors or similar proceeding; (iii) upon a change in ownership of either Party such that the Parties no longer share a holding-subsidiary relationship. Upon any such termination for cause, the Client shall pay any outstanding fees and expenses owed to the Service Provider for Services rendered and agreed upon expenses incurred prior to the date of such termination, within 7 (seven) days of such termination.

4. **Effect of Termination.**

Upon termination or expiration of this Agreement for any reason:

(a) all Services shall cease;

(b) Client shall pay Service Provider for all Services rendered and fees accrued up to the effective date of termination; and

(c) All SEO-related content assets, including without limitation text, keywords, metadata, and creative materials generated under the Services (collectively, the “Content Assets”), shall vest in and remain the property of Customer. Client acknowledges that all enhancements, modifications, or improvements made during the term are part of the Services and shall be retained by Customer following termination, unless otherwise agreed in writing.

5. **Suspension.** Service Provider may suspend Services immediately (without constituting breach) for: (a) non-payment overdue more than fifteen (15) days; (b) Client’s unlawful use of Services; (c) cybersecurity or regulatory compliance risk; or (d) Client’s material breach pending cure.
6. **Survival.** The obligations of the Parties under Sections 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 15, 16 and 17 shall survive the termination of this Agreement or any SOW executed pursuant to this Agreement
